title: 第013章 反超机会来了第014章 难以克制的喜爱
lines: 答完第二题，苏恒扫了一眼其他人的答题效率，大部分人还困在第二题，他就收敛心情继续了。
接下去第三题，靠着强大的知识底蕴，苏恒再次于一两秒内判断出正确答案，一路抵达第11题得分20后，他才被一个迷惑性、陷阱更多的题目困住了。
这个题也是选择题。
整个解体过程，不比上次王媛媛拿来撩他的考研题难度弱多少，苏恒不是不会解，是要认真仔细思考，注意里面的陷阱别被绕弯路，同样要注意时间。
不要忘了，这样的竞赛其他人如王会，于飞煌也可能拿到满分100分的，本科题库随机出，选题人只筛选难易比例，最终一旦不止一个人得满分，谁最强看的就是你答题的时间。
“咦，王教授，看来苏恒未必不是你喜欢的脚踏实地的学生啊，现在开考几分钟，小伙子就20分了，很不错啊，他还已经是现场第一名。”
苏恒势如破竹解题，高台上俯瞰全场的李跃才笑着调侃了一声同伴。
开考两三分钟，除了苏恒就是3号李亚琳得分最高，18分，回答了9题全部正确。
第一人大热门王会才16分，回答八道题全部正确，排名第三。
于飞煌这个心高气傲的少年，常年的全系第二名也是16分，和王辉一样解答8题，只是用时比王会多了十几秒。
剩余的郭耀光、杜邵阳、张宏等学霸们，答题进度已经有人追上苏恒了，但正确率？？杜邵阳答完10题，总分才16，已经错了两题！
王维峥表情微动，认真看了苏恒一眼，才淡然笑道，“行了，你就不用刺激现场，给其他选手施加心理压力了，能登上这个舞台的没有谁心理素质太弱，我还是认为，一时运气好坏决定不了最终结果。”
苏恒暂时领先，这有什么用？没什么用处，大家就算拿到的试卷一样，可开场选择题，有时候你回答正确不一定是靠知识判断出来的，傻子也知道，选择题这东西，很多时候觉得两三个答案都很模糊，似乎都正确……随便选一个，可能是对可能是错。
前面十道题，陷阱和迷惑性都不少，有时候还要去发散思维猜测出题人的立场和隐藏的东西。
选择题一时领先不重要，等后面到了大题阶段，才需要学生们引经据典，一步步计算运算的，少一个步骤或公式就会扣分，那才是考验你全面实力的。
李跃的话无非是给那些自视甚高的家伙，增加一点心理压力，一旦心理素质不行，急了……就会急中出错，这是电脑答题，答过直接出分数，修改机会都没有。
选择题判断题，一个心急漏了某个知识点，或手滑一下，得分就截然不同的。
王教授的话，说到了其他18名选手的心坎里，实力第一，至少是自认或公认第一的王会，就在此刻不屑的瞥了眼苏恒，眼中的嫌恶呼之欲出。
以前任何小考试、实践，都不会实时公布成绩，小考试做完试卷还能审查几遍。
只有全明星赛，这种超级大赛里考核的才是所有，一个人的所有。
“虽然知道这是全明星赛的恶趣味，我也懂任何一个强者，都要有泰山崩于前而色不变的心理素质，不管任何时候都要细心、耐心，有着强大的判断力才能走到最强，可被这么一个吊丝压在头上，暂时压制也是压制啊，槽。”
“前面几道题这么刁，以前从没见过，陷阱那么多，我都废了一定脑子，那货运气那么好？”
心下吐槽一声，王会深呼吸一次人也更冷静了，就凭他王会，10岁接触修炼，比苏恒足足早了五年，大量的天赋灵植和灵丹妙药砸下来，还有私人教师辅导，他这样的富三代，怎么可能是苏恒那种泥腿子能比肩的？
让他先飞一下又如何，王会有绝对自信轻易追上，反杀，一定可以！
content_en:
After answering the second question, Su Heng glanced at the other people's answering efficiency. Most of them were still stuck on the second question, so he calmed down and continued.
Moving on to the third question, relying on his strong knowledge base, Su Heng once again determined the correct answer within a second or two. After reaching the 11th question and scoring 20 points, he was trapped by a confusing question with more traps.
This question is also a multiple choice question.
The entire disintegration process was no less difficult than the last postgraduate entrance exam question that Wang Yuanyuan used to tease him. It wasn't that Su Heng couldn't solve it, but that he had to think carefully and carefully, pay attention to the traps and avoid detours, and also pay attention to time.
Don’t forget that other people like Wang Hui and Yu Feihuang may also get a perfect score of 100 in this kind of competition. The undergraduate question bank is randomly selected, and the question selector only screens the difficulty ratio. In the end, once more than one person gets a perfect score, who is the strongest depends on your answer time.
…………
"Hey, Professor Wang, it seems that Su Heng may not be the down-to-earth student you like. A few minutes into the exam, the young man has scored 20 points. It's very good. He is already the first place on the scene."
Su Heng solved the problem like a champ, while Li Yuecai, who was overlooking the audience from the high platform, smiled and teased his companion.
Two or three minutes into the exam, besides Su Heng, No. 3 Li Yalin scored the highest, with 18 points, and answered all 9 questions correctly.
Wang Hui, the first favorite, scored 16 points and answered all eight questions correctly, ranking third.
Yu Feihuang, a proud and arrogant young man, always ranked second in the entire department with 16 points. He answered the same 8 questions as Wang Hui, but it took more than ten seconds longer than Wang Hui.
Among the remaining academic masters such as Guo Yaoguang, Du Shaoyang, and Zhang Hong, some have already caught up with Su Heng in answering questions, but the accuracy rate? ? After Du Shaoyang answered 10 questions, his total score was only 16. He already got two questions wrong!
Wang Weizheng's expression moved slightly, and he took a serious look at Su Heng before smiling calmly and saying, "Okay, you don't need to stimulate the scene and put psychological pressure on other contestants. No one who can get on this stage has too weak psychological quality. I still think that good or bad luck cannot determine the final result."
Su Heng is temporarily ahead, what's the use? It's of no use. Even if everyone gets the same test paper, for the multiple-choice questions at the beginning, sometimes your correct answer may not be judged by knowledge. Fools also know that for multiple-choice questions, many times two or three answers are very vague, and they all seem to be correct... Just pick one at random, it may be right or wrong.
The first ten questions are full of traps and confusions, and sometimes you have to use divergent thinking to guess the position and hidden things of the questioner.
It doesn't matter if you lead the multiple-choice questions at the moment. When you get to the big question stage later, students are required to quote classics and calculate step by step. If you miss a step or formula, you will lose points. That is the test of your overall strength.
Li Yue's words are nothing more than adding a little psychological pressure to those guys who think highly of themselves. Once the psychological quality is not good enough, they will make mistakes in a hurry. This is a computer answer question. Scores will be given directly after the answer, and there is no chance to revise.
For multiple-choice questions, if you miss a certain knowledge point in a hurry or slip your hand, your score will be completely different.
Professor Wang's words spoke to the hearts of the other 18 players. Wang Hui, who was number one in strength, or at least considered himself or recognized as number one, glanced at Su Heng with disdain at this moment, the disgust in his eyes ready to come out.
In the past, the results of any small exams or practices would not be announced in real time. After completing the small exams, the test papers could be reviewed several times.
Only the All-Star Game, a super competition like this, assesses everything, a person's everything.
"Although I know that this is the bad taste of the All-Star Game, I also understand that any strong person must have the mental quality to remain calm despite the collapse of the mountain. He must be careful and patient at all times, and have strong judgment to be the strongest. But with such a hanging thread weighing on his head, temporary suppression is also suppression, bummer."
"The first few questions are so tricky. I have never seen them before. There are so many traps. I have lost a lot of my brain. How can I be so lucky?"
…
He groaned in his heart, and Wang Hui took a deep breath and became calmer. He, Wang Hui, started practicing cultivation at the age of 10, five years earlier than Su Heng. He received a large number of gifted spiritual plants and elixirs, as well as tutoring from private teachers. How could a third-generation rich man like him be as good as Su Heng with his weak legs?
It doesn't matter if you let him fly first. Wang You will be absolutely confident that he can easily catch up and kill him, he can definitely do it!
